messages:
Ellen: Kicking off NewChip EAP. Partner asked for a 3-day bench window, strict telemetry (no raw prompts), and a short NDA addendum. Who owns which piece?

Marco: I'll run benches. Lab slot 10/11-10/13 UTC. Hardware: 2x NC-64 boards. Plan: latency sweep, mem-heavy run, 12h soak.

Priya: Marketplace/comms here. We'll need SVG logo + 2-sentence blurb + partner quote for co-list. ETA for assets?

Ellen: Telemetry: partner only allows aggregated counters + salted hashes. No plaintext prompts or responses. Need that in NDA.

LegalBot: Draft clause: "Exchange limited to aggregated metrics and salted cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) of request identifiers; no plaintext prompts/responses may be retained or exchanged. Test artifacts retained up to 60 days and encrypted with KMS." Will upload draft.

Marco: Bench flags: `./bench --model=redwood-7b --seq=2048 --batch=1 --samples=300 --cache=on|off`. Capture `p50,p95,p99,gpu_util_pct,kv_hit_rate`. Save artifacts as `newchip_<date>_<phase>.json`.

Priya: I'll chase logos and quote template. Suggest we prepare a 75-word blurb emphasizing low-latency on NewChip silicon.

OpsBot: Uploaded checklist: `drive.redwood.com/newchip/eap-playbook.md` (telemetry schema, bench matrix, repro scripts).

Ellen: Timeline: Legal draft today; Marco bench runs + upload by 10/12; Priya blurb + assets by 10/14; soft co-list target 10/24. Sync Tue 9am UTC to review artifacts.

Marco: I'll include a short runbook and sanitized example outputs. Example sanitized line: `\{"model\":\"redwood-7b\",\"p95_ms\":110.3,\"gpu_util\":78.1\}`.

Priya: Noted. Will prepare blurb and loop in comms.

Ellen: Action recap: Marco -> bench + artifacts; Priya -> blurb/assets; LegalBot -> NDA addendum; OpsBot -> keep playbook updated. Keeping thread canonical for NewChip EAP. :thumbsup:
